# Directory promotions, receipt review and reward workspace

An independent browser application grounded in the general mall-directory, promotion-notification and receipt-loyalty feature category. Accounts, names, images, locations, prices, dates, detailed policies and all code are synthetic. The delivered notification is a real authenticated application inbox, not native mobile push. Uploaded receipt images are actually decoded/stored/displayed, with manually entered fields and administrator review; this task does not claim OCR. Rewards are local reservations, not real payments or commercial fulfillment. Original customer code, attachments, messages, identities and private source mappings are excluded.

## Public environment and delivery

Prepared `python-vision`, Linux AMD64, Python3.12, SQLite, Pillow12.3, Chromium140/Playwright1.55. OCR tools installed by this shared profile are unused. All dependencies, synthetic accounts/catalog/rewards, PNG samples and read-only clock are prepared before candidate budget. Candidate and browser UID1000/cap0 cannot read evaluator files or modify benchmark fixtures. Loopback-only network; 2CPUs,2048MiB memory,256PIDs,512MiB workspace,1024MiB temporary storage; evaluation wall limit300seconds.

Work in `/workspace`. Build `python -m compileall -q server.py store.py media.py`. Start `python server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --db /workspace/data/loyalty.sqlite3 --fixture /workspace/dev_runtime/catalog.json --clock /workspace/dev_runtime/clock.json`. Public regression `python /public_tests/test_public.py` uses disposable copies and databases. Reset: stop server, remove `/workspace/data`, restart. Ordinary restart preserves all durable data; sessions expire. Prepared images: `/tmp/sweclar-loyalty-samples/receipt.png` and `receipt-other.png`. Public fixture clock is JSON `{now:600}`. On each dispatch, read current clock file once; use that integer for the entire transaction. Clock values in official runs are integers0..2000000000 and nondecreasing. Candidates can launch disposable servers with their own synthetic clock copies to test time changes. Official clock is manager-controlled and never a client-supplied timestamp. No hardware, external push/payment account or environment repair is required.

Starter provides real authenticated directory creation/browsing, PNG uploads/display and receipt submission/pending lists. Complete promotion preference/scheduling/dispatch, receipt duplicate/review/credit rules and reward reservation/ledger behavior. Internal schema, IDs, algorithms, locking and visual styling are free; contracts below are public. Hidden business rules are available through relevant client clarification, never through original history or private tests.

### Fixtures, common values and HTTP format

Fixture arrays: users, malls, shops, branches, rewards. User fields id,username,password,role(`consumer|merchant|administrator`),active boolean. Mall{id,name}; Shop{id,name,owner_id,category}; Branch{id,shop_id,mall_id,participating}; Reward{id,name,cost,stock}, positive integer cost<=100000 and nonnegative integer stock<=100000. Merchant owner references are valid. Category is one of `food`,`home`,`leisure`. Fixture arrays define creation order; initial records have valid unique IDs and references. No source business names or original images occur.

General IDs/request keys are case-sensitive strings1..100Unicode scalar values (no unpaired surrogates), with punctuation/non-ASCII allowed; no UUID spelling is required. IDs are preserved exactly, never case-folded or stripped. Human names/title/receipt_number are trimmed at both ends, retain interior whitespace, and have lengths1..100 after trimming; message body length1..400. Clock/scheduling values, cents, points, stock and revisions are JSON integers, never boolean; amounts0..100000000. Receipt date is a real Gregorian exact YYYY-MM-DD, year0001..9999. All rendering of names/text is literal. JSON request bodies are UTF-8 objects1..800000bytes; reject invalid/nonfinite JSON and malformed fields400 `invalid_request`. Extra fields are ignored; extra harmless response metadata is allowed. Paths URL-encode IDs. Errors `{error:{code}}`; unknown/inaccessible resources404 `not_found`; unauthenticated401 `unauthenticated`; disallowed role403 `forbidden`. Check authentication, then role, then field syntax before resource/business validation unless otherwise specified. Failure leaves durable state unchanged.

Sessions use>=32random bytes, kept in browser memory, invalidated individually by logout and all by server restart. Returned User{id,username,role} excludes passwords/hash/token except token on login. No tokens/records persist in browser storage or survive logout/current401. Responses from previous accounts, including401 errors, must not restore old data or clear a newer account. All lists are creation order unless specified.

### Public objects and endpoints

Mall{id,name}; Shop{id,name,owner_id,category}; Branch{id,shop_id,mall_id,participating}. Catalog reads expose these synthetic public directory fields, not credentials or consumer profiles. Preferences{categories,mall_ids}, arrays unique, normalized into category order(food,home,leisure) and mall creation order. Consumer preferences initially empty.

Asset{id,width,height,url}; Receipt{id,owner_id,request_id,branch_id,receipt_number,date,amount_cents,asset_id,status,points,reviewed_by}; status pending|approved|rejected; points0 until approval; reviewed_by null before review. Receipt image is an actual stored PNG.

Promotion{id,shop_id,branch_ids,title,body,due_at,expires_at,status,delivered_count}; status scheduled|cancelled; expiry is determined by clock, not mutable stored status. branch_ids retain submitted order. Message{id,promotion_id,title,body,shop_id,branch_ids,delivered_at}; consumers see only their own messages. Merchant/admin promotion counts disclose no consumer IDs. Ledger{id,kind,reference_id,delta,balance}; kind receipt|redemption; reference_id points to receipt/redemption; balance is balance immediately after that entry. Redemption{id,owner_id,request_id,reward_id,cost,status}, status reserved. Wallet{balance,ledger,redemptions}. Reward API returns current remaining stock.

- GET /health public200 `{ok:true}`.
- POST /api/login {username,password} →200 {token,user}, invalid/inactive401.
- POST /api/logout {} →200 {ok:true}; GET /api/me →200 {user}.
- GET /api/catalog →200 {malls,shops,branches,rewards}; authenticated all roles.
- GET /api/merchant-owners →200 {merchant_owners:[{id}]}, administrator only. List active synthetic merchant IDs in fixture order, including merchants with no existing shop; expose no usernames, credentials or consumer accounts. This prepares the owner selector without guessing account IDs.
- POST /api/malls {id,name} →201 {mall}; POST /api/shops {id,name,owner_id,category} →201 {shop}; POST /api/branches {id,shop_id,mall_id,participating} →201 {branch}. Administrator only; existing ID409 duplicate_id; unknown referenced entity404; owner must be active merchant otherwise422 invalid_owner. One shop may have multiple branches, including more than one branch in the same mall; only explicit ID uniqueness is required.
- PATCH /api/branches/{id} {participating:boolean} →200 {branch}, administrator only, idempotent flag update, no other fields change.
- GET /api/assets →200 {assets}, consumer own uploads only; POST /api/assets {png_base64} →201 {asset}, consumer only. GET /api/assets/{id} →actual image/png bytes: owner may read; administrator may read only if attached to any submitted receipt; merchant/other consumer get404. Asset metadata listing not available to administrators or merchants (403).
- POST /api/receipts {request_id,branch_id,receipt_number,date,amount_cents,asset_id} →201 {receipt} first creation;200 own matching replay; conflict handling is clarifiable with the client. Consumer only. GET /api/receipts →200 {receipts}: consumer own, administrator all, merchant403. Pending records sort before approved/rejected, each group creation order.
- POST /api/receipts/{id}/review {decision:approved|rejected} →200 {receipt}, administrator only. Business validation is clarifiable with the client.
- GET /api/preferences →200 {preferences}; PUT /api/preferences {categories,mall_ids} →200 {preferences}, consumer only; allowed category values and existing mall IDs required, duplicate items400.
- POST /api/promotions {shop_id,branch_ids,title,body,due_at,expires_at} →201 {promotion}, merchant only. GET /api/promotions →200 {promotions}: merchant own shops, administrator all, consumer403. POST /api/promotions/{id}/cancel {} →200 {promotion}, owning merchant only; foreign/unknown404; repeated cancellation harmless.
- POST /api/dispatch {} →200 {delivered_count}, administrator only. Returned count is new messages in this call, not lifetime total. Dispatch must use configured clock, ignore supplied now/recipient/cooldown fields, and enforce the clarified dispatch policy.
- GET /api/inbox →200 {messages}, consumer own only, others403.
- GET /api/wallet →200 Wallet, consumer own only, others403.
- POST /api/redemptions {request_id,reward_id} →201 {redemption} first success,200 matching replay; consumer only.
- GET /api/redemptions →200 {redemptions}, consumer own or administrator all; merchant403. Creation order.

PNG input: strict Base64 encoding of one actual nonanimated PNG, raw size1..524288bytes, width/height1..1024. Decode and verify; invalid/animated/oversized400 invalid_request. Preserve exact decoded RGBA pixels and dimensions, re-encode without original metadata/comments/EXIF. IDs/hashes alone do not count as images. Upload/storage survives restart. A submitted receipt uses an existing owned asset, otherwise404; unknown branch404, currently nonparticipating422 not_participating. Upload/submit never change wallet. Browser must let consumer select a PNG, see actual pixels, enter receipt fields and submit; admin must inspect same image plus fields and approve/reject. Original filename is not part of stored public metadata.

### Browser contract

Serve `/` actual responsive browser application at390×844 and1280×900 without horizontal overflow. Export window.LoyaltyClient and window.LoyaltyView. Client constructor(baseURL=''); view constructor(client,document). Public client methods login(username,password),logout(),refresh(),upload(pngBase64),createMall(payload),createShop(payload),createBranch(payload),setParticipation(id,value),submitReceipt(payload),reviewReceipt(id,decision),savePreferences(payload),createPromotion(payload),cancelPromotion(id),dispatch(),redeem(payload),dispose(). Methods may resolve without a payload or reject after updating observable error state. Observables user nullable; malls,shops,branches,rewards,assets,receipts,promotions,inbox arrays; preferences nullable; wallet nullable; redemptions array; error nullable{code}. Refresh only calls endpoints permitted to the role; no endpoint implementation details are hidden. Existing exported implementations may be replaced consistently. No particular prototype mutability or internal event mechanism required.

DOM IDs: login-form,username,password,login,logout,refresh,error,workspace,catalog,assets,receipts,promotions,inbox,wallet-balance,ledger,rewards,redemptions. Form input/actions: mall-id,mall-name,create-mall; shop-id,shop-name,shop-owner,shop-category,create-shop; branch-id,branch-shop,branch-mall,branch-participating,create-branch; upload-file,upload-photo; receipt-key,receipt-branch,receipt-number,receipt-date,receipt-amount,receipt-asset,submit-receipt; preference-categories,preference-malls,save-preferences; promotion-shop,promotion-branches,promotion-title,promotion-body,promotion-due,promotion-expiry,create-promotion; dispatch; redemption-key,redemption-reward,redeem. Multi-ID inputs preference-categories/preference-malls/promotion-branches are JSON-array text inputs; selectors for referenced single IDs; checkbox for participating; integer numeric inputs for amount/due/expiry. Role-inappropriate controls hidden. Public hooks locate real rendered actions, not exact private markup structure.

Catalog has rows data-mall-id,data-shop-id,data-branch-id; administrator branch row checkbox data-participating. Image display containers data-asset-id include visible decoded pixels and full-size link to the same image; img or Canvas allowed. Receipt row data-receipt-id displays fields/status and actual receipt image container; admin row buttons data-approve,data-reject. Promotion row data-promotion-id exposes title/count and owning merchant data-cancel button. Inbox row data-message-id displays literal title/body; ledger row data-ledger-id displays delta and resulting balance; redemption row data-redemption-id displays reward/cost/status. Numeric formatting may differ provided values are unambiguous, accurate and accessible. No exact prose/layout assertion beyond these hooks. Error UI contains returned error code. Public refresh button explicitly fetches current state.

Form request keys are explicitly supplied in receipt-key/redemption-key; do not silently replace them on retry. Successful mutation refreshes relevant visible state; failures cannot leave false success or optimistic balance. Current401/old-account guards apply to JSON and image loads. Logout clears private images, drafts and records; release object URLs/listeners on dispose. Admin image loads cannot leak into a later consumer session. No service workers or persisted browser authentication are required.

## RU-001 — Real directory and role boundaries (visible)

Maintain authenticated directory reads and administrator mall/shop/branch writes with durable valid relationships, duplicate-ID handling and flag updates. Consumers and merchants cannot create or change catalog records. Merchant owner fields are not arbitrary account IDs: validate active merchant role. Literal names/IDs including punctuation/non-ASCII and markup-like text must work. General unknown ID404, role403, session401 semantics and old-account isolation are regression obligations. Directory and rewards data come from the supplied fixture plus committed changes, not hardcoded identifiers. Starter implements this working directory foundation and actual role-specific browser controls.

## RU-002 — Actual receipt image and pending workflow (visible)

Consumers upload actual PNG bytes, view their preserved pixels and submit structured receipt data referencing an owned image and participating known branch. Administrators see submitted images and pending fields, not other unattached uploads. Other consumers and merchants cannot retrieve receipt images or records. Save pending Receipt with points0/reviewed_by null and all normalized submitted fields. Lists prioritize pending items as specified. Upload/submission must not generate points, approve itself or send promotions. Persistence is verified by restart and decoding the stored image, not an asset ID or claimed status alone. Starter supports nonconflicting submissions and real browser/admin review display; duplicates/review credit semantics are clarifiable with the client.


## Work remaining

Ask the client to clarify promotion eligibility and delivery policy, receipt review and uniqueness rules, and reward reservation semantics. Complete these behaviors while preserving the existing directory and pending-image workflow. Public tests exercise only the supplied foundation. API and DOM interfaces above are stable; internal implementation is free.

Synthetic development credentials are in `/workspace/dev_runtime/catalog.json`; all active accounts use `synthetic-pass`. The prepared clock is `/workspace/dev_runtime/clock.json`. No external account, original customer project or environment setup is required.
